Defined in: core/tokens/motion/carousel.ts:45

Px-space chase-spring for the programmatic slide scroll — the organic, slightly elastic slide travel that replaced the browser's fixed behavior:'smooth' ease (which can't overshoot and ignores velocity on retarget). Integrated by springStep in core/utils/motion with px-space epsilons — same integrator the slider knobs run.

ωn = √96 ≈ 9.8 rad/s, ζ = 20/(2·√96) ≈ 1.02

ζ≈1.02 is the critical-damping boundary — the slide travels fast and parks on the target with no visible swing-back (a measurable under-damped overshoot read as bounce on full-slide travel); the ~0.6s settle keeps single-step navs snappy while multi-slide dot jumps land without a hard stop.
